app.title: Course setter
app.tagline: Set orienteering courses on your club's maps and print them at the right scale.

common.error: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

auth.signInPrompt: Sign in with your Google account to see your clubs.

clubs.heading: Your clubs
clubs.empty: You are not in a club yet. Create one, or ask an admin of your club for an invite link.
clubs.createHelp: You become the club's first admin and can invite the other members.

club.notFound: This club does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

maps.heading: Maps
maps.emptyAdmin: Upload an OCAD or PDF map to start setting courses on it.
maps.emptyMember: Club admins upload the maps. They show up here when they are ready.
maps.processing: Version {{number}} ({{file}}) is being processed. This takes a minute or two.

errors.not_ocad: the file is not an OCAD map.
errors.unsupported_ocad_version: this OCAD format version is not supported. Save the map as OCAD 2018 or OCAD 12 and upload it again.
errors.not_pdf: the file is not a PDF.
errors.unreadable_file: the file could not be read. It may be damaged.
errors.processing_failed: something went wrong while processing it. Try uploading it again.

maps.notFound: This map does not exist, or it has no version you can see yet.
maps.deleteConfirm: Delete version {{number}} of {{map}}? Its files are removed for good.

upload.heading: Upload a map
upload.help: An OCAD (.ocd) or PDF map, up to 50 MB.
upload.name: Map name
upload.scaleHelp: A PDF does not store its scale. Give the scale the map is drawn at, for example 15000 for 1:15 000.
upload.ocadScale: The scale is read from the OCAD file.
upload.badScale: Give the scale as a whole number between 500 and 100 000.
upload.wrongType: Choose an OCAD (.ocd) or PDF file.
upload.tooLarge: The file is {{size}}; the limit is 50 MB.
upload.done: Uploaded. The map appears in the list when it has been processed.

events.heading: Events
events.emptyHelp: Events need a map. Once one is uploaded, courses are set here.

members.heading: Members
members.name: Name
members.leaveConfirm: Leave {{club}}? You need a new invite link to come back.
members.lastAdmin: A club must have at least one admin. Make someone else admin first.

invites.heading: Invite links
invites.help: Anyone with a link can sign in with Google and join as member.
invites.shareHelp: Share the link in the club chat. People who open it sign in with Google and join as members.

settings.heading: Club settings
settings.nameHelp: Shown to members and on invite links.
settings.adminsOnly: Only admins can change the club settings.

invite.heading: Join a club
invite.signedOut: You have been invited to join a club on Course setter. Sign in with Google to see the invite.
invite.valid: You have been invited to join {{club}}.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already a member of {{club}}.
invite.expired: This invite link to {{club}} has expired. Ask a club admin for a new one.
invite.revoked: This invite link to {{club}} is no longer valid. Ask a club admin for a new one.
invite.unknown: This invite link is not valid. Check that you copied all of it, or ask a club admin for a new one.

viewer.measureHelp: Click on the map to measure; double-click to finish.
